topic: ego and needing to be right
lines: You argue about who left the lights on.
A monk once asked a kid why a candle trembles.
The kid answered, because the air moves.
The monk said, because the flame fights the air.
Your stubbornness is the moving air; truth is the steady flame.
When you stop pushing, the light stays calm.
Let the light burn for you, not for your ego.
Follow if this touched your heart.
cta: Follow if this touched your heart.
caption: Quiet the wind, keep the light. Save this if you’re ready to stop the blame game.
